items.source: Variant of DeferredResult(Long, Object) that accepts a dynamic fallback value based on a Supplier.
items.translation: `DeferredResult(Long, Object)` 的变体，接受基于 `Supplier` 的动态回退值。

items.source: timeoutValue - timeout value in milliseconds (ignored if null)
items.translation: timeoutValue - 以毫秒为单位的超时值（如果为 null 则被忽略）

items.source: An example of associating additional behavior to this class might be realized by extending the class to implement an additional interface. For example, one might want to implement Comparable so that when the DeferredResult is added to a PriorityQueue it is handled in the correct order.
items.translation: 将附加行为与此类关联的一个示例是通过扩展该类以实现额外的接口。例如，可能需要实现Comparable，以便当将DeferredResult添加到PriorityQueue时，能够按正确的顺序进行处理。

items.source: This method is called from a container thread when an async request times out before the DeferredResult has been populated. It may invoke setResult or setErrorResult to resume processing.
items.translation: 此方法在异步请求超时且 `DeferredResult` 尚未填充时，由容器线程调用。它可能会调用 setResult 或 setErrorResult 来恢复处理。

items.source: This method is called from a container thread when an error occurs while processing an async request before the DeferredResult has been populated. It may invoke setResult or setErrorResult to resume processing.
items.translation: 此方法在异步请求处理过程中、DeferredResult 尚未填充时发生错误，由容器线程调用。它可能会调用 setResult 或 setErrorResult 以恢复处理。

items.source: Subclasses can extend this class to easily associate additional data or behavior with the DeferredResult. For example, one might want to associate the user used to create the DeferredResult by extending the class and adding an additional property for the user. In this way, the user could easily be accessed later without the need to use a data structure to do the mapping.
items.translation: 子类可以扩展此类，以便轻松将附加数据或行为与 DeferredResult 关联。例如，可以通过扩展该类并添加一个用于用户的额外属性，来关联创建 DeferredResult 的用户。通过这种方式，以后可以轻松访问该用户，而无需使用数据结构进行映射。

items.source: The result may have been set with a call to setResult(Object), or setErrorResult(Object), or as a result of a timeout, if a timeout result was provided to the constructor. The request may also expire due to a timeout or network error.
items.translation: 结果可能通过调用 setResult(Object) 或 setErrorResult(Object) 设置，或者如果构造函数提供了超时结果，则可能是由于超时而设置。请求也可能因超时而过期，或因网络错误而过期。

items.source: This method is called from a container thread when an async request completed for any reason including timeout and network error. This is useful for detecting that a DeferredResult instance is no longer usable.
items.translation: 此方法在异步请求因任何原因（包括超时和网络错误）完成时，由容器线程调用。这对于检测 `<code>DeferredResult` 实例不再可用非常有用。

items.source:
By default not set in which case the default configured in the MVC
Java Config or the MVC namespace is used, or if that's not set, then the
timeout depends on the default of the underlying server.
items.translation: 默认情况下未设置，此时将使用在 MVC Java 配置或 MVC 命名空间中配置的默认值；如果该值也未设置，则超时时间取决于底层服务器的默认值。

items.source: Set an error value for the DeferredResult and handle it. The value may be an Exception or Throwable in which case it will be processed as if a handler raised the exception.
items.translation: 为 `DeferredResult` 设置错误值并处理它。该值可以是 Exception 或 Throwable，在这种情况下，它将像处理器抛出异常一样进行处理。

items.source: Return the result, or null if the result wasn't set. Since the result can also be null, it is recommended to use hasResult() first to check if there is a result prior to calling this method.
items.translation: 返回结果，或者如果未设置结果则返回 `null`。由于结果也可能为 `null`，建议在调用此方法之前先使用 hasResult() 检查是否存在结果。

items.source: Set an error value for the DeferredResult and handle it.
items.translation: 为 `DeferredResult` 设置错误值并处理它。

items.source: Return true if the DeferredResult has been set.
items.translation: 如果 DeferredResult 已设置，则返回true。

items.translation: 创建 DeferredResult。

in case of timeout.
items.translation: 创建一个带有超时值和默认结果的 `DeferredResult`，以便在发生超时时使用。

items.translation: 设置 DeferredResult 的值并处理它。

items.translation: 提供用于处理结果值的处理器。

items.source: true if the result was set and passed on for handling; false if the result was already set or the async request expired
items.translation: true 如果结果已设置并传递给处理程序； false 如果结果已设置或异步请求已过期。

items.source: true if the result was set to the error value and passed on for handling; false if the result was already set or the async request expired
items.translation: 如果结果已设置为错误值并传递用于处理，则为`true`；如果结果已设置或异步请求已过期，则为`false`。

items.translation: 返回结果，如果未设置结果则返回null。

items.source: Return true if this DeferredResult is no longer usable either because it was previously set or because the underlying request expired.
items.translation: 如果此 DeferredResult 已不再可用（无论是由于之前已被设置还是底层请求已过期），则返回true。

items.source: Handles a DeferredResult value when set.
items.translation: 设置时处理 DeferredResult 值。

items.translation: 创建具有自定义超时值的 DeferredResult。
